meta.name: alien_farmtown
meta.prompt: An alien invasion world: a peaceful farming town under attack — crashed and hovering UFOs scattered across the fields and hills, crop circles, a massive mothership landmark looming over the town, abduction beams, panicked barricades in the streets

briefs: A massive hovering alien mothership looming over the farming town, with a broad dark hull, glowing underside and a colossal luminous abduction beam descending toward the town.

A family of alien saucers scattered across farm fields and hill slopes, with per-instance variation between intact hovering craft and crashed, tilted or half-buried wrecks. Hovering craft can cast vertical luminous abduction beams, while crashed sites leave impact scars and debris.
Grounded crop-circle sites pressed into working farmland: flattened crop rings, radial tracks, disturbed soil and an eerie central alien residue marker, with each instance using a different pattern.

An improvised panicked street barricade assembled from overturned farm carts, timber, hay bales, warning signs and rope, leaving a narrow passage for pedestrians and turning each site into a different desperate roadblock.
